# `aitbc explorer non-empty-blocks`

List non-empty blocks with optional limit, offset, and chain filters.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc explorer non-empty-blocks [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--limit` | integer | `10` | no | Number of blocks to return |
| `--offset` | integer | `0` | no | Offset for pagination |
| `--chain-id` | text | — | no | Chain ID to query |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc explorer non-empty-blocks
```
